title: YEEZY SLIDE INFANT
description: The Yeezy Slide Infant 'Bone' dropped in December 2019 as part of a Yeezy sandal collection made for the whole family. Finished in an understated and neutral hue, the miniature slip-on differs from its full-sized counterpart by adding an adjustable strap at the heel for an extra secure fit. The soft yet durable foam build rides atop a ripple outsole, good for added traction and comfort.

title: YZY QNTM KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum Kids ‘Barium’ makes use of a grey jacquard knit inlay reinforced with a translucent RPU cage on the side panels. A synthetic suede toe cap delivers added durability, while reflective detailing throughout the upper provides enhanced visibility in low-light conditions, including the seamless external heel counter. The midsole features a full-length Boost unit in a semi-translucent TPU cage.

title: YEEZY 450
description: The adidas Yeezy 450 ‘Resin’ showcases a pale green monochrome finish throughout the sneaker’s futuristic build, which comprises a one-piece knit upper and a claw-like EVA midsole, complete with tapered ‘fingers’ that wrap up the side panels. Details include tonal rope laces, a stretchy sock-like cuff, and an Ortholite insole marked with dual adidas and Yeezy branding. Underfoot, a contoured rubber outsole features a wavy traction pattern for optimal grip.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘MX Cream Clay’ enlivens Kanye West’s amphibious slip-on with a swirling blend of brown and grey. The neutral hues appear to have been painted on the surface of the cream-colored one-piece upper, crafted from a combination of lightweight EVA and hydroponically produced algae. Ventilation ports of varying sizes ensure breathable comfort, while the sculpted design keeps the foot locked in place.

title: YEEZY SLIDES INFANT
description: The 2022 edition of the adidas Yeezy Slide Infant ‘Bone’ brings back an understated design originally released in 2019. A subtle shade of tan is executed on a one-piece build made with injected EVA foam. Unlike the mainline release, this scaled-down version features a wraparound heel strap for an extra-secure fit. The slip-on is underpinned by a sawtooth outsole, featuring deep grooves that deliver a blend of cushioning and grip.
